name: tokenhop
description: tokenhop CLI - Start and manage tokenhop server

scripts.dev: nodemon -I --watch cli.js --watch src --watch hooks --ext js,json cli.js
scripts.publish:cli: node -e "console.error('This package is published only by CI (.github/workflows/release-npm.yml) with npm trusted publishing. Do not publish manually.')" && exit 1

comment_sqlite: sql.js + better-sqlite3 are NOT bundled here. They are installed into <data dir>/runtime/node_modules by hooks/postinstall.js (and re-checked at runtime by cli.js). This avoids Windows EBUSY errors when updating the global CLI, since native .node files no longer live under the locked install dir.
comment_systray: systray2 is NOT bundled here. It is lazy-installed into <data dir>/runtime/node_modules by hooks/postinstall.js on macOS/Linux only. Windows uses PowerShell NotifyIcon (zero binary). This avoids shipping unsigned Go binaries that trigger antivirus false positives (Kaspersky). We use the systray2 fork because the legacy systray@1.0.5 ships a 2017 x86_64 binary that fails on modern macOS dyld.
